related.title: ERPNext Ledger：複式分錄與沖銷軌跡
related.titleEn: ERPNext Ledger: double-entry postings and reversal trails
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 stock-ledger.csv、重播測試與不變量逐列檢核。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver stock-ledger.csv,replay tests and row-by-row invariant checks.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 先按transaction_id與currency分組核對零差額；再核對收入/稅科目分類，證明兩組皆平衡但業務含義不同。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Group by transaction_id and currency to verify zero difference,then inspect account classification to show both balanced entries mean different things. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 100-30-20 = 50 available-units；對照 (100-30)-20 = 50 available-units。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
逐事件列on_hand/reserved/available：初保留後100/50/50，出貨後70/20/50；另核對出貨加在庫仍為100。

基準 1000-900-100 = 0 currency-units；對照 1000-800-200 = 0 currency-units。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
先按transaction_id與currency分組核對零差額；再核對收入/稅科目分類，證明兩組皆平衡但業務含義不同。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 100-30-20 = 50 available-units; comparison (100-30)-20 = 50 available-units. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
After reservation track100/50/50,and after shipment70/20/50;verify shipped plus on-hand remains100.

Baseline 1000-900-100 = 0 currency-units; comparison 1000-800-200 = 0 currency-units. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Group by transaction_id and currency to verify zero difference,then inspect account classification to show both balanced entries mean different things.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: UNIX 管線：描述元生命週期與 EOF
related.titleEn: UNIX pipelines: descriptor lifetime and EOF
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 stock-ledger.csv、重播測試與不變量逐列檢核。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver stock-ledger.csv,replay tests and row-by-row invariant checks.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 畫出 parent/child 到同一管線的四條邊，逐次記錄 close、write、read；把空緩衝與 EOF 畫成不同狀態。
related.differenceEn: Draw four parent/child edges to one pipe. Trace close, write and read, distinguishing an empty buffer from EOF.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 100-30-20 = 50 available-units；對照 (100-30)-20 = 50 available-units。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
逐事件列on_hand/reserved/available：初保留後100/50/50，出貨後70/20/50；另核對出貨加在庫仍為100。

管線是位元組串流；讀端只有在緩衝區空且所有寫端關閉後才得到 EOF。fork 複製描述元參照，不複製獨立管線。
本課數值核對：2*2 = 4 endpoint_references；另一項核對：3*4 = 12 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline 100-30-20 = 50 available-units; comparison (100-30)-20 = 50 available-units. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
After reservation track100/50/50,and after shipment70/20/50;verify shipped plus on-hand remains100.

A pipe is a byte stream. A reader observes EOF only when its buffer is empty and every writer is closed. fork duplicates descriptor references, not the pipe itself.
Numeric audit: 2*2 = 4 endpoint_references; second audit: 3*4 = 12 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
